evals.name: bringup-and-health
evals.prompt: Give me an exact runbook to start Intel Multimodal DataPrep with the default prebuilt VDMS and MinIO stack and verify readiness. Do not launch containers.
evals.expected_output: Exports placeholder MinIO credentials and an embedding model, sources setup.sh --nosetup, starts docker/compose.yaml with --no-build, requires embedding_client_status=preloaded, and checks MinIO and VDMS separately.
expectations: Uses the intel/multimodal-dataprep prebuilt image through setup.sh --nosetup and docker compose --no-build
Uses placeholder values for MINIO_ROOT_USER, MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD, and EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME
Separately checks MinIO and VDMS reachability

evals.name: choose-milvus
evals.prompt: I want Multimodal DataPrep to store vectors in Milvus while keeping raw media in MinIO. Which deployment artifact and settings should I use?
evals.expected_output: Uses docker/compose-milvus.yaml, explains MM_DATAPREP_VECTORDB_BACKEND=milvus and MM_DATAPREP_STORAGE_BACKEND=minio, uses a Milvus-safe collection name, and verifies Milvus plus media MinIO separately.
expectations: Names the vector and storage backend selector values
Warns that Milvus collection names cannot use the default hyphenated VDMS name

evals.name: upload-video
evals.prompt: The service is healthy on localhost:6007. Give me the exact request to ingest /data/forklift.mp4 while sampling every 10th frame; do not claim it was uploaded.
evals.expected_output: Uses multipart POST /v1/dataprep/media/upload with file=@/data/forklift.mp4 and frame_interval=10 as a query parameter.
expectations: Uses frame_interval=10 as a query parameter

evals.name: ingest-image-url
evals.prompt: Show me how to ingest https://example.com/camera.jpg as a remote image and tag it camera-2 without downloading it locally first.
evals.expected_output: Posts JSON to /v1/dataprep/media/ingest using type=image_url, image_url, and tags.
expectations: Uses the typed image_url discriminator and includes the tag

evals.name: delete-media-safely
evals.prompt: Delete the ingested media item video-summary/dp_video_1730000000 and its embeddings. Explain the scope before giving the request; do not call the API.
evals.expected_output: Warns that the operation deletes the whole media directory and matching vectors, then gives DELETE /v1/dataprep/media/video-summary/dp_video_1730000000. It does not invent a video_name query option.
expectations: Explains that deletion covers storage objects and vector records for the bucket/video_id
Does not claim single-file deletion through video_name is supported

evals.name: directory-batch
evals.prompt: I mounted a camera drop directory into the DataPrep container. Submit it as an asynchronous batch and show how to poll the job.
evals.expected_output: Uses POST /v1/dataprep/media/ingest-dir with a dir_path constrained beneath MM_DATAPREP_INGEST_DATA_ROOT, captures job_id, and polls GET /v1/dataprep/media/jobs/{job_id}.
expectations: Mentions the configured ingest root and path traversal restriction
